_comment: Hard limits for scripts/audit/ux-pass.mjs at phone width. Set on 2026-10-15: the largest page after the step 3 fix drew ~8,800 DOM nodes and blocked ~850 ms on a fast machine; before the fix step 3 drew ~51,000 nodes and blocked ~9 s there (~18 s on a phone). The limits sit well above today's pages, so runner speed does not decide the result, and well below the freeze. Lower them as pages get lighter; never raise one to make a run pass. Per page: `ready` names content that must have rendered (an unrendered page is light and would pass), and `click` presses a control up to N times and holds the result to the same limits.
